title: Finite fibre dimension is represented by a natural number
statement: For affine schemes X and T and a locally finitely presented morphism f : X ⟶ T, every point y : X admits a natural number n equal to the topological Krull dimension at f.asFiber y.

proof.text: Apply upstream topologicalKrullDim_ne_top_of_compactSpace to the affine finite-type fibre. Local dimension is at most global dimension and nonnegative because each neighbourhood contains the point; extract a natural number from WithBot ENat.

proof_origin.note: Upstream finite-type dimension bound and the definition of local dimension.
